column1: # engines/needs.tsv -- what each database needs on the machine (Ubuntu 24.04), written once. engines/setup.sh installs
# what is missing (`just setup-engines`); engines/check-tools.sh checks the same rows before a build or a server start.
# Tab-separated: db, when, how, what, check.
#   when   build: engines/<db>/build.sh needs it. run: the server's start and stop (engines/<db>/lifecycle.sh) need it.
#          profile: timing the engine's KV store from outside needs it (time_queries.py --storage-profile), with
#   how    apt: the Ubuntu package `what`. go: Go at version `what`, unpacked into /usr/local/go (engines/env.sh puts it
#          on PATH; dgraph's go.mod line 3 says `go 1.24.3`, and our binaries were built with it). service: the systemd
#          service `what` must answer. main: comes with the main README's Needs; setup.sh reports it, installs nothing.
#   check  cmd:<a program on PATH> | pkg (the package is installed, by dpkg-query) | sh:<a shell test, exit 0 when met>
# Why each: Go also builds NebulaGraph's console and importer (its justfile's setup-console, setup-nebula-importer).
# perf is Ubuntu's linux-tools (the wrapper of linux-tools-common runs the running kernel's linux-tools-<version>,
# which linux-tools-generic brings for the generic kernel). Dgraph's `make install` builds jemalloc first (curl, bzip2, make, gcc); its server runs in tmux and its
# health checks read JSON with jq. NebulaGraph builds inside its dev image (nebulagraph/scripts/start-container.sh runs
# `sudo docker`, so no docker group is needed). ArangoDB configures with clang-17 and its archiver llvm-ar-17, links
# the GCC 14 C++ library (without libstdc++-14-dev CMake's compiler test fails with "cannot find -lstdc++"), OpenMP,
# OpenSSL, Boost and BLAS; its bundled ICU 64's configure runs python3 ($PYTHON when set) and imports distutils, which
# Python 3.12 has only through setuptools. TuGraph is not built: its release package is fetched (curl) and unpacked
# (rpm2cpio, cpio); our counter library is one C file (gcc; binutils checks the release's symbols).
